pr_title: streamingccl: support AddSSTable operation in producer processor
pr_body:
This PR makes producer processor (event stream value generator)
support RangefeedSSTable event, prune it and send it over to
consumers in the ingestion side.

Release note: None

Closes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/79309
